article.title_es: St. Brendan & St. Ann Parish: despensa de alimentos en el Bronx
article.title_en: St. Brendan & St. Ann Parish: food pantry in the Bronx
article.summary_es: St. Brendan & St. Ann Parish es una despensa de alimentos en el Bronx, en la calle East 207th Street. Abre los sábados por la mañana.
article.summary_en: St. Brendan & St. Ann Parish is a food pantry in the Bronx, on East 207th Street. It is open on Saturday mornings.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está en 268 E 207th St, Bronx, NY 10467.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the Food Help NYC map.
Located at 268 E 207th St, Bronx, NY 10467.
visit_tips_es: La despensa abre solo los sábados, de 7:30am a 9am.
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide algún requisito.
Llame al (718) 547-6655 antes de ir para confirmar los detalles.
visit_tips_en: The pantry is open only on Saturdays, 7:30am to 9am.
It is not listed what food is given or if there are any requirements.
Call (718) 547-6655 before going to confirm the details.
